title: हिसाब
logline: Mausi has put two paper folds in Kiran's palm and wants Aditya dead by her hand before dawn. Kiran buys a fresh glass of milk, uses the minutes on the landing to put one number in Billu's head, and carries the glass to Aditya with the boys' hands on his shoulders. Then Mausi tells her there was never going to be a last wedding or a payout.
language_note: Hinglish: Hindi in Devanagari, English words in Latin script, in the same line.
script_note: Hinglish: Hindi in Devanagari, English words in Latin script

characters.name: किरण (Kiran)
characters.role: LEAD. The bureau's vanishing bride. Tonight she has to pour a full dose into a man's milk with Mausi watching.
characters.look: Indian woman, 27, about 5 ft 3, slight and wiry. Wheat-brown skin, oval face, straight dark brows, large kajal-lined eyes, closed watchful mouth. Low bun, centre parting with sindoor, small round red bindi, thin plain gold ring in the LEFT nostril, small gold studs, short black-bead mangalsutra. Plain sindoor-red matte saree with a 1 cm gold zari border, red elbow-sleeve blouse, pallu over the left shoulder, barefoot. Old-style block henna on both hands (a solid disc in each palm, fingertips dipped). Red-and-ivory chooda on both forearms, each a red cuff about 10 cm long with a pale band at each end; the LEFT cuff is complete and covers the scar in every shot.
characters.voice_note: Female, late 20s, alto with a dry edge. Small-city Madhya Pradesh Hindi. With Mausi she says आप and sounds younger; with Billu तू, flat and quick; with Aditya तुम, very few words. Under pressure she gets quieter and more exact, never shrill. Lies come easily; true things come after a pause.

characters.name: आदित्य (Aditya)
characters.role: The groom. Mohit's brother. Held on a chair by the boys; tonight Mausi means him to die by Kiran's hand.
characters.look: Indian man, 33, about 6 ft, tall and narrow, slight stoop. Light-brown skin, long clean-shaven face, neat left-parted black hair, rimless rectangular glasses on in every shot, including lying with his eyes shut. Plain cream cotton-silk wedding kurta with band collar, sleeves folded back once, cream churidar, barefoot. A brass key about 5 cm long on a doubled red thread, outside the kurta at mid-chest, in every shot. Plain steel watch, brown strap, left wrist.
characters.voice_note: Male, early 30s, light baritone, soft-spoken, educated small-city Hindi. Even and unhurried, almost courteous. Under pressure he slows down and drops in volume; he never shouts. Two lines in this episode, both low.

characters.name: शकुन मौसी (Shakun Mausi)
characters.role: Runs the brides. The only mother Kiran has had. Came in person tonight to settle the groom.
characters.look: Indian woman, 56, about 5 ft 2, broad and heavy-shouldered. Brown skin, round face, heavy-lidded shrewd eyes, paan-reddened lips and a smile that arrives before she speaks, large round maroon bindi, small gold nose stud, grey-streaked hair in a tight oiled bun. Starched bottle-green cotton saree with a narrow mustard border, pallu pinned on the left shoulder, mustard elbow-sleeve blouse, thin gold chain, rubber slippers. A steel ring of about eight keys at her LEFT hip. A dozen plain green glass bangles on each wrist.
characters.voice_note: Female, mid 50s, low, warm and grainy, a paan-chewer's unhurried mouth. Bundelkhand-side Hindi, Hindi-heavy, trade English only (party, booking). An endearment in every second line. Laughs easily. Never raises her voice: the colder the decision, the softer and slower she gets. Fully voiced in every line, never a whisper.

characters.name: बिल्लू (Billu)
characters.role: The bride's 'brother', driver and lookout. Tonight he hears his first number.
characters.look: Indian man, 30, about 5 ft 7, wiry and restless. Brown skin, sharp jaw, patchy stubble, black hair gelled straight back. Faded blue denim jacket with the sleeves pushed up over a black round-neck T-shirt, dark jeans, white sneakers gone grey. A wooden toothpick in the right corner of his mouth (it stays in all episode). A car key on a plain steel ring hooked on his right index finger. Aditya's grey phone is in his jacket pocket, not shown.
characters.voice_note: Male, about 30, light tenor, fast, a little nasal, talks round a toothpick. Small-town Bundelkhand street Hindi. Usually cocky and quick, and 'हाँ मौसी' comes out at once. In this episode the jokes have stopped: both of his lines are slow, and the last 'हाँ मौसी' arrives late.

characters.name: छोटी (Chhoti)
characters.role: The next bride in training. Her first wedding is booked. Voice on Mausi's phone only in this episode.
characters.look: Not seen in this episode. Voice only, on Mausi's phone speaker.
characters.voice_note: Female, 19: a young woman's voice, not a child's (D-007 direction 14). Bright, quick, sing-song, a giggle in the breath, small-town Hindi with a phone's English. Her second line goes small and the giggle disappears. Phone-filtered in the mix.

characters.name: लड़के (The boys)
characters.role: Billu's two silent helpers. Their hands hold Aditya on the chair until they lay him on the bed.
characters.look: Never a face. Hands, backs, shoulders and silhouettes only, any head cropped, turned away or in full shadow. One heavy-set with a shaved head and a maroon track jacket; one thin, in a checked shirt and a cloth cap.
characters.voice_note: No lines. Any breath or effort is a sound effect, not a cast voice.

location: The bridal bedroom on the first floor of the rented house, and the landing outside its pale-blue door. Bedroom: double bed with a dark wood headboard against the back wall, white sheet, one red bolster, loose marigold petals, marigold strings above the headboard; pale-green lime-washed walls. Facing the bed from its foot: window in the RIGHT wall (iron grille, shutters open), grey-green steel almirah against the LEFT wall with the wooden chair beside it, the door behind. A low stool on the window side of the bed holds the steel tray. The door stands open: the hasp hangs torn out of the wood, the brass padlock still locked on it. Landing: a small concrete landing at the top of one narrow straight flight, damp-stained cream walls, one bare yellow bulb.
time_of_day: Night 1, about 4:35 to 5:05 am, late April. Bedroom light state 2 (amber lamp, cold streetlight through the grille, the landing bulb spilling yellow through the open door) for b1 to b5; state 3 (pre-dawn blue in the window) from b6 to b9.

beats.action: Opens inside the last image of s1b01. Shot 1, insert, under the silence (the hook): Kiran's LEFT hand palm up, two small white paper folds lying on the solid henna disc, the edge of the complete red cuff at the wrist; Mausi's fingers, green glass bangles, just leaving them. Shot 2, l01: Kiran single, standing, eyes on the old steel glass on the tray; her left hand has closed on the folds. Shot 3, l02: Aditya single on the wooden chair by the almirah, glasses on, key on its red thread, two hands gripping his shoulders from behind (the boys, heads out of frame); his eyes on her fist. Shot 4, l03: Billu single by the open door, toothpick, car key on his finger, the torn hasp beside him. Shot 5, l04: Mausi single, seated on the edge of the bed among the marigolds, keys at her hip, pleased. On the tray beside the old glass: the night-one fold, half emptied, as left in s1e01. Aditya's black notebook, the photograph inside it, lies on the sheet beside Mausi.

beats.action: No line. Geometry: Mausi stands close in front of Kiran, her back to the doorway, one hand at Kiran's cheek, her eyes on Kiran's face; Kiran's body blocks her view of the pillow. Billu has crossed to the stool on the window side and is bent over the tray wiping the glass, his back to the bed. Aditya lies on the bed behind Kiran. Billu stays outside the frame in every shot of b9 (heard only, cloth on steel). Shot 1, insert, about 2.0 s, close from behind Kiran: her left hand behind her back, the fist opening; on the henna disc two white paper folds, still folded shut and crisp; the complete red cuff at the wrist. Shot 2, about 1.4 s: over Mausi's shoulder (back of her head, green pallu and her hand at Kiran's cheek only), Kiran facing her, and beyond Kiran the bed, Aditya among the marigolds, eyes shut, glasses on, key on his chest; the stool and Billu are outside the frame, to its right. Shot 3, about 1.8 s: extreme close on Aditya's face, behind the rimless glasses one eye open a slit, turned toward Kiran's back. Shot 4, about 0.8 s: the same framing, the eye shut. Cut to black.

sfx_notes: Bed, whole episode: warm late-April night through the open window, crickets, a distant truck on the highway, one far dog in b1 and b3. No ceiling fan anywhere in this episode: Mohit died hanging from a fan, and the sound would point at it.
b1: under the opening silence, a faint crinkle of paper as Mausi's fingers leave Kiran's palm and the chink of her green glass bangles; her keys settle at her hip as she sits.

b2: hard concrete reverb on the landing, the low hum of the bare bulb, Billu's car key ticking on its steel ring. No sound for the toothpick stopping. His sneakers going down the concrete stairs after l08. The bed ducks under l08 so बारह is clear.
b3: room tone; from far below, very faint, a steel pan on a gas flame and milk coming to the boil.

b4: two small dry taps of paper on steel and a soft stir in milk, starting a few frames before l14 and running under it; nothing else from the tray. Cloth and creak as the boys' hands tighten under l17. The whisper is NOT recorded: no voice, no breath that a transcript could catch. The room tone dips for it and holds. Then two quiet swallows over the drinking shot.
b5: the steel glass set down on the steel tray; a creak of the bed and a rustle of marigold petals as he is laid down; Mausi's bangles chink once as she strokes Kiran's hair under l18.

b6: Mausi's phone rings, a generic cheap-phone ringtone, no song; the first ring lands on b5's fist insert. Chhoti through a speaker filter (narrow band, consonants kept clear). Mausi's l21 is in the room, unfiltered.
b7: the bed thins out; a first bird outside the grille under l26. Under l27 the bed ducks right down so every word is clear.
b8: Billu's key ring still. The 1.0 s silence sits between Mausi's l28 (end of b7) and l29, so the late 'हाँ मौसी' is heard as late. Nothing under l29 but room tone.

b9: near silence. A cloth on steel under shots 1 to 3 (Billu wiping the glass at the tray, out of frame). One early bird. No breath from Aditya. Cut to black on the eye shutting, and hold one beat of silence before the end sting.
music_note: No music in b1 and b2: room, paper, bulb. A low sustained drone enters under b3 (two calm people) and holds very low through b4; it drops out completely for the unheard whisper and the drinking, so the silence is felt. Nothing under Chhoti's call. In b7 a single warm, slightly detuned harmonium-like note sits under Mausi's 'तू मेरी बेटी है' and ducks out under l27. b9: one low note on the fist opening, a thin rising tone on the eye, cut to black on silence, then a short sting.
ending_question: आदित्य ज़िंदा है और ये सिर्फ़ किरण जानती है: मौसी, बिल्लू और लड़कों से भरे इस घर से वो उसे, और ख़ुद को, बाहर कैसे निकालेगी?

Gate 0b measured real eleven_v4 takes running 20 to 60 per cent over their targets, so targets here are set at about 8 characters a second, slower than the skill's 9 to 10, with short and emotional lines given more. Spoken 102.8 s, 18 speaker changes at 0.3 s (5.4 s), silences 17.8 s: 126.0 s in all (critic round 1 added 1.0 s of silence to b4 and 0.2 s to l03). That is above D-007's 120 s aim and under the 135 s ceiling. If measured takes still run long, cut in this order: l13, l11, l03, then shorten l02 to 'दो और नहीं घुलेंगी।'. Do not cut l05 to l08, l17, l26 or l27.
D-007 direction 8: Billu says his figure aloud, 'बारह', against Kiran's 'बाईस तोला', then 'मौसी ने कहा है।'. 'चौदह' is not used. s1b03 b2 builds on this.

D-007 direction 9: Mausi sees a reason for him to drink: the insert of the boys' hands tightening, Kiran aloud 'पी लो। नहीं तो ये पिला देंगे।', then the whisper nobody hears. writer_notes in the bible: neither the spoken text nor the subtitles say what she whispered or what is in the glass before b9. The whisper has no line, no text and no subtitle; it is a silent shot.
What Kiran taps and stirs at the tray is not shown: her hands are under the pallu and nothing is seen falling. s1b03 b3 says there was only kesar in the milk; the storyboard must not show powder.

b4, for the ledger only: the paper tapped is the night-one fold, tapped still folded shut; nothing falls from it, and it goes back on the tray half full (consistent with s1b03 l11, only kesar in the milk). Nothing is shown. Props placed in b1 for the ledger: the night-one fold, half emptied, on the tray beside the old glass (as left in s1e01), and Aditya's black notebook with the photograph inside it on the sheet beside Mausi (she closed it on the print in s1b01 b11; s1b03 b5 needs the print on the sheet beside him). In b9 the two crisp folds in Kiran's palm are the only folds in frame.

D-007 direction 17: the boys' hands stay on Aditya's shoulders from b1 until they lay him down in b5; they are on screen as hands in b1, b3, b4 and b5. After b5 they stand back by the almirah, out of frame or as edge shapes with no head. They never speak.

D-007 direction 16: no frame holds more than two sheet faces. Every beat is written as singles and two-shots; b9 shot 2 shows Kiran's face and Aditya's, with Mausi as the back of a head and a hand, and Billu outside the frame.

Kiran's left hand: she holds the two folds in her LEFT fist from b1 to b9 (Mausi put them in that palm in s1b01 b11). She uses her RIGHT hand for the old glass, the tray and the new glass. The left cuff is complete in every shot and the palm faces up only in the two inserts, so the scar (outer forearm) never shows. For prompts, sides go in picture terms per D-013 rule 3.

b9 geometry is set so that Aditya, on the bed behind Kiran, could see her open palm while nobody else can see him: Mausi stands close in front of Kiran with her eyes on Kiran's face and Kiran's body between her and the pillow, and Billu is bent over the tray at the stool with his back to the bed. The ending question ('ये सिर्फ़ किरण जानती है') depends on this. Whether Aditya saw the folds is left open for s1b03. s1b03 b1 (Mausi turning toward the door, Billu stepping toward the bed) follows from this position.

Bible b2 says 'they have never laid a hand on anyone', but Billu's bio says he slaps and frightens a groom who wakes. l05 says what is true for both: 'आज तक हमने किसी की जान नहीं ली।'. This fits choice.why_B_is_not_villainy.

Chhoti's wedding is booked for day 3 and this call is at about 4:50 am, so कल and परसों are both ambiguous. l20 uses 'इतनी जल्दी' instead, as the beat outline does ('so soon'); Mausi's 'अगले महीने की booking' in l23 is Kiran's next party, not Chhoti's.
l10 'मेरे बिना नहीं खुलती।' is his pharmacist's licence, set up in s1e01 b8, and is paid off by Kiran's 'दुकान खोलो' in s1b03 b7.
One word per object (register): पुड़िया, दूध, हिसाब, गाड़ी. 'गिलास' is the only word for the glass. ताला and चाबी are not spoken. No यह or वह anywhere; spoken ये and वो only.

Tags: [calm], [quietly], [laughs], [chuckles], [sighs], [sharply], [excited] and [nervous] were used in the proof scenes. [flatly] (l16, l29) and [hesitant] (l08) are in the 'verify in casting first' group; if a voice ignores them, swap them for [calm] and [quietly] (l08's fallback is '[quietly] बारह। मौसी ने कहा है।'). l08 carries one tag only, so the binding figure 'बारह' is not split by a second tag; its slowness is in the picture (the toothpick dead still). [warmly] on l26 is unconfirmed for Mausi's voice (her casting test lines used it but nobody has listened yet); fall back to [calm] if ignored. No [whispers] is used: the episode's only whisper is the unheard one. [sharply] means low and fast, never loud. Mausi is never tagged louder than [laughs].

Short turns: l16 'पूरी।', l29 'हाँ मौसी।' and l15 'पूरी पुड़िया?' are one or two words. Flag them for extra takes (D-011 allows up to four for lines of one to three words) and keep them unpadded. l29 is meant to come late: Billu's usual 'हाँ मौसी' is instant. The delay is built in: l28 now ends b7, and b8's 1.0 s silence plays before l29.
